requirements.ears: The Elm desktop SHALL pass native host tests for IME preedit, keyboard navigation, Orca and braille, clipboard, file drag-and-drop, fractional scale and negative output coordinates.

scenarios.then: composition commits or cancels without duplicate/missing characters and restores the documented focus

scenarios.then: taskbar, switcher, menus and settings are reachable and escapable with visible focus

scenarios.name: host-orca

scenarios.then: current control name/state and focus transitions are announced correctly

scenarios.name: host-clipboard

scenarios.then: copied content transfers to the intended selection without stale ownership

scenarios.name: host-file-dnd

scenarios.then: the accepted payload reaches the intended destination once and cancelled drags cause no action

scenarios.name: host-scale

scenarios.then: rendered and hit-tested control bounds correspond in the target scale

scenarios.name: host-negative-output

scenarios.then: popups and hit coordinates remain inside the correct output bounds
